mapper.sql: select l.link_id, l.supplier_id, l.person_id, l.person_name, l.link_type, l.hold_ratio, l.source_type, l.evidence, l.verify_status, l.handle_result, l.handle_time, l.handle_by, l.handle_opinion, l.rectify_issue_id, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.update_by, l.update_time, l.remark, s.supplier_name as supplier_name, i.issue_no as issue_no from jc_supplier_link l left join jc_supplier s on s.supplier_id = l.supplier_id left join jc_rectify_issue i on i.issue_id = l.rectify_issue_id
mapper.select: where l.supplier_id = #{supplierId} order by l.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into jc_supplier_link ( supplier_id, person_id, person_name, link_type, hold_ratio, source_type, evidence, verify_status, handle_result, rectify_issue_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark ) values ( #{supplierId}, #{personId}, #{personName}, #{linkType}, #{holdRatio}, #{sourceType}, #{evidence}, #{verifyStatus}, #{handleResult}, #{rectifyIssueId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark} )
mapper.update: update jc_supplier_link set handle_result = #{handleResult}, verify_status = #{verifyStatus}, handle_time = sysdate(), handle_by = #{handleBy}, handle_opinion = #{opinion}, rectify_issue_id = #{rectifyIssueId}, update_by = #{handleBy}, update_time = sysdate() where link_id = #{linkId}
mapper.select: select count(1) as total, sum(source_type = '系统比对') as auto, sum(rectify_issue_id is not null) as toRectify, sum(handle_result = '0') as pending from jc_supplier_link where del_flag = '0'
select link_type as name, count(1) as value from jc_supplier_link where del_flag = '0' and link_type is not null and link_type <> '' group by link_type order by value desc

select s.supplier_name as name, count(1) as value from jc_supplier_link l join jc_supplier s on s.supplier_id = l.supplier_id where l.del_flag = '0' group by s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name order by value desc limit 10
